newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai crusher to buy soybean, soymeal price steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai crusher to buy soybean, soymeal price steady.

text.p: Activity in the Thai grains market improved this week with one producer buying 50,000 tonnes of South American soymeal and an oil crusher seeking to buy the same amount of soybeans, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The buyer of the soymeal was agri-business giant Charoen Phokphand which ordered 35,000 tonnes of hi-pro soymeal and 15,000 of low-pro for July shipment.
"The nearby demand for soymeal seemed to be well-covered. Besides this deal, I only heard of some enquiries for April shipmeent," a source from an American trading house here said.
Thai Vegetable Oil was seeking to buy 50,000 tonne of US soybeans for March shipment, the sources said, adding that the deal should be concluded within this week.
Local stocks of soymeal were depleting but the prices were mostly steady due to imported supplies. Prices were quoted around 9.30-9.40 baht ($0.37), barely changed from last week.
Corn prices edged up slightly as buying activities picked up and was quoted around 4.30-4.35 baht a kg this week.
But so far there have been no imports as local demand was still sufficient and the market awaited the government announcement on a new schedule for zero-tariff corn imports.
